# C++ unit tests and examples of the generated bindings (include/, generated by `mise run generate-bindings`),
# run with CTest.
# Expects the Rust library to be built first (`cargo build -p ecitygml-ffi`); `mise run test-bindings-cpp` does both.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(ecitygml_ffi_cpp_tests LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

set(REPOSITORY_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../..")
set(ECITYGML_FFI_LIBRARY_DIR "${REPOSITORY_ROOT}/target/debug" CACHE PATH "Directory with libecitygml_ffi")
set(FIXTURES "${REPOSITORY_ROOT}/tests/fixtures")

include(FetchContent)
FetchContent_Declare(
    Catch2
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/catchorg/Catch2.git
    GIT_TAG v3.16.0
    GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(Catch2)

find_library(ECITYGML_FFI ecitygml_ffi PATHS "${ECITYGML_FFI_LIBRARY_DIR}" NO_DEFAULT_PATH REQUIRED)

add_executable(ecitygml_ffi_tests
    tests/test_auxiliary_traffic.cpp
    tests/test_bridge.cpp
    tests/test_building.cpp
    tests/test_city_model.cpp
    tests/test_construction.cpp
    tests/test_geometry.cpp
    tests/test_gml_reader.cpp
    tests/test_physical_space.cpp
    tests/test_road.cpp
    tests/test_space_boundary.cpp
    tests/test_traffic_area.cpp
    tests/test_traffic_space.cpp
    tests/test_vegetation_furniture_relief.cpp
)
target_include_directories(ecitygml_ffi_tests PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
target_link_libraries(ecitygml_ffi_tests PRIVATE "${ECITYGML_FFI}" Catch2::Catch2WithMain)
target_compile_options(ecitygml_ffi_tests PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra)
target_compile_definitions(ecitygml_ffi_tests PRIVATE ECITYGML_FIXTURES="${FIXTURES}")
# Find libecitygml_ffi at runtime (Linux doesn't search its directory otherwise).
set_target_properties(ecitygml_ffi_tests PROPERTIES BUILD_RPATH "${ECITYGML_FFI_LIBRARY_DIR}")

include(CTest)
include(Catch)
catch_discover_tests(ecitygml_ffi_tests)

# Examples, also run as tests against the expected output shared by all languages.
set(EXAMPLE_SOURCE_EXTENSION cpp)
include(../../tests/examples/examples.cmake)
